---
title: "Where Is Crime Concentrated in Boston?"
author: "Simon Zhang"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

crime_map <- st_read(
  "../data/processed_data/boston_crime_map_2025.geojson",
  quiet = TRUE
)

crime_categories <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed_data/crime_categories_2025.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

crime_monthly <- read_csv(
  "../data/processed_data/crime_monthly_2025.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(crime_map)
```

## Figure 1

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(crime_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = crime_count),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reported Crime Across Boston Neighborhoods",
    subtitle = "Unique reported incidents in 2025",
    fill = "Incidents"
  ) +
  theme_void()

p1
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  "../figures/crime_by_neighborhood.png",
  p1,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 2

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(crime_map) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = crime_rate_per_1000),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reported Crime Rate Across Boston",
    subtitle = "Reported incidents per 1,000 residents in 2025",
    fill = "Incidents\nper 1,000"
  ) +
  theme_void()

p2
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  "../figures/crime_rate_by_neighborhood.png",
  p2,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 3

```{r}
p3 <- ggplot(
  top_crimes,
  aes(
    x = offense_count,
    y = reorder(CRIME, offense_count)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Most Common Police Incident Types in Boston",
    subtitle = "Top 10 reported incident types in 2025",
    x = "Number of Reported Incidents",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p3
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  "../figures/top_crime_categories.png",
  p3,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Figure 4

```{r}
crime_monthly <- crime_monthly |>
  mutate(
    MONTH = as.integer(MONTH),
    month_name = factor(
      month.abb[MONTH],
      levels = month.abb
    )
  )

p4 <- ggplot(
  crime_monthly,
  aes(
    x = month_name,
    y = crime_count,
    group = 1
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reported Crime by Month in Boston",
    subtitle = "Unique reported incidents in 2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Incidents"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = comma
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p4
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  "../figures/crime_by_month.png",
  p4,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Neighborhood Comparison

```{r}
neighborhood_summary <- crime_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    neighborhood,
    population,
    crime_count,
    crime_rate_per_1000
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(crime_rate_per_1000)
  )

neighborhood_summary
```

# Highest Crime Counts

```{r}
crime_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    neighborhood,
    crime_count
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(crime_count)
  ) |>
  head(10)
```

# Highest Crime Rates

```{r}
crime_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(
    neighborhood,
    population,
    crime_rate_per_1000
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(crime_rate_per_1000)
  ) |>
  head(10)
```
